target.access: dashboard Worker /api/status through the in-memory Durable Object and GitHub fixtures

checks.evidence: A 60-minute queued snapshot row with an expired confirmation was answered by the exact-run fixture as completed; /api/status returned healthy with queued_over_threshold=0, the row disappeared, and eviction telemetry named the completed verdict.
reproduction_steps: Seed a queued workflow row older than the workflow confirmation TTL
Preserve it across a fresh census boundary
Return completed from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect the read model plus telemetry

checks.evidence: The same stale row with an exact-run 404 produced healthy status, zero queued-over-threshold count, durable eviction, and telemetry with verdict=absent.
reproduction_steps: Seed and preserve the stale queued row
Return HTTP 404 from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect the read model plus telemetry

checks.evidence: When the exact-run fixture still returned queued, /api/status remained degraded with queued_over_threshold=1 and the row's confirmation timestamp advanced.
reproduction_steps: Seed and preserve the stale queued row
Return queued from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect health plus the refreshed observation

reproduction_steps: Seed a workflow row only through repair
Persist complete census coverage without a workflow_run delivery
Return an empty live Actions status census
